points.quote: Do not copy and paste GenAI-generated content into assignments.
points.gist: Do not copy and paste GenAI-generated content into assignments.

points.quote: Keep a screenshot of conversations or outputs in your appendix where required.

points.quote: Always acknowledge and reference any tools you use, following university guidance.

points.quote: Check all GenAI-generated information against reliable academic sources.

points.quote: Be careful when uploading personal, confidential or copyrighted material.
points.gist: Be careful when uploading personal, confidential or copyrighted material.

points.quote: Please check with your course instructor about the use of Generative AI in accordance with each module specifications.
points.gist: Check with your course instructor about GenAI use in line with each module's specifications.

points.quote: GenAI can be a useful study tool, but you are the author and responsible for the accuracy, originality and integrity of your work.
points.gist: GenAI can be a useful study tool, but the student is the author and is responsible for accuracy, originality and integrity.
